summary.text: Sisay is the Zhalfirin captain of the skyship Weatherlight, known for seeking the Legacy to destroy the Lord of the Wastes and as the ancestor of Shanna.

bio.text: Phyrexians raided Sisay's village and orphaned her, and she later set out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it could kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.

She inherited the Weatherlight after the Zhalfirin family that held it was killed, and her crew grew to include Tahngarth, who became first mate, and later Gerrard and others shaped by the bloodline project.
The Phyrexian servant Starke betrayed Sisay and captured her and the Legacy, delivering her to Volrath's Stronghold on Rath to lure Gerrard there.

Gerrard led the Weatherlight to Rath, freed Sisay and retook the Legacy, and the ship then crashed on Mercadia, where Sisay gathered artifacts to repair it and helped lead the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.
When the Phyrexian Invasion began she helmed the Weatherlight in many battles until it crashed when the Primeval Dragons attacked, and she crashed the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.
Gerrard, Urza and Karn merged to complete the Legacy and defeat Yawgmoth, and the Weatherlight sank near Urborg, so Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee were given a new vessel named Victory.

status.text: Sisay is spoken of in later stories as a late former captain and as Shanna's ancestor, whom Jhoira knew; her last recorded act is sailing the Victory a year after the Invasion.
